title: HHHusher product hero
description: A dark product opener. Left, a large 1.7 photo with four thumbnails and two long thin tan arrows to step through them (phones add an n/4 counter); right, the product name in a large light weight, a price row with the old price struck through, the new one bold, an outlined tag and a mono note, two paragraphs, and a quantity stepper with cream squares beside a yellow checkout button that empties to an outline on hover.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); pairs with hhhusher-header
images are placeholders until you pass media
the gallery and stepper need JavaScript (hydrate: load)
name: hhhusher-product-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the product name, one entry per line

props.name: images
props.description: the gallery, shown large with a row of thumbnails

props.name: badge
props.description: a small outlined tag after the price, e.g. "-15%"

props.name: priceNote
props.description: a mono note after the tag, e.g. "This month"

props.name: guarantee
props.description: a small mono line next to (desktop) or under (phones) the button

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous: string; next: string; decrease: string; increase: string; quantity: string; }
props.default: { previous: "Previous image", next: "Next image", decrease: "One less", increase: "One more", quantity: "Quantity" }
